name: heading_lexgate
rationale: Strictly dominates the deployed incumbent on the 20260723 cohort: removes 86.0% of bibliography characters against 53.9%, while destroying 0.258% of body characters against 0.505%. Better on both axes simultaneously.

measure_change_required.note: This candidate does not clear the historical 0.98 line-precision gate (0.95921). The recommendation rests on replacing line precision with a character-denominated body-damage budget, because the incumbent scores 0.9788 line precision but 0.9127 character precision - its false positives are long lines. Adopting this model means adopting that change of measure.

sealed_one_shot.label_semantics: dual-terra-high consensus silver, binary A/B agreement 0.99733

conditions_before_corpus_scale_use: Corpus-scale dry run reporting per-document removal-rate distribution (no labels required)
Eyeball a sample of removed spans, including bibliography abbreviation lists
Hold the scope threshold at 0.98-0.99; looser settings buy recall at roughly 1:1 body damage
known_limitations: Kallipos recall 0.677 at this operating point; 170 gold blocks against 91 predicted components
n=150 with heavy tails: three documents moved pooled precision by 1.8 points
Cohort 2 labels are now open; a future unbiased read needs a fresh seal
The body-damage level 0.00025 was calibrated on the 20260718 cohort, not derived from a stated tolerance
